expectations.text: Uses the CMMC scoping categories: CUI assets, Security Protection Assets, Contractor Risk Managed Assets, Specialized Assets, out-of-scope — with correct treatment of each
expectations.evidence: Lists only four categories (CUI Assets, SPAs, CRMAs, Out-of-Scope); Specialized Assets omitted

expectations.text: Endorses the enclave pattern: concentrate CUI processing/storage/transmission behind a defined boundary to shrink the assessment scope
expectations.evidence: "one of the most common and legitimate ways to reduce CMMC/NIST 800-171 scope"; "only the enclave (and the security tools protecting it) fall under... assessment scope"

expectations.text: Requires CUI dataflow mapping (entry, storage, movement, exit — email, file shares, endpoints, cloud)
expectations.evidence: "Do a data flow mapping exercise first: where does CUI actually enter (email, portals, physical media...)"; controlled ingress/egress incl. email, file transfer, backups, endpoints

expectations.text: Covers external providers: CSPs holding CUI need FedRAMP Moderate or equivalency; ESPs/MSPs enter scope via Security Protection Asset treatment
expectations.evidence: No mention of FedRAMP Moderate or equivalency for CSPs holding CUI; ESP/MSP FedRAMP-side treatment not covered

expectations.text: Covers flow-down: Level 2 for subs receiving CUI, Level 1 for FCI-only subs, DFARS 7012 flows down
expectations.evidence: No subcontractor flow-down coverage (Level 2/Level 1, DFARS 7012 flow-down)
